desc_en: A black base with its own attitude. These high-waisted leggings combine a streamlined ankle-length silhouette with distinctive gold-olive details. The design features a wide, elasticated waistband positioned above the natural waist for coverage and support. Crafted from a lightweight, soft, and smooth fabric with slight elasticity, they move naturally with the body. Ideal for demanding training sessions or moments of rest.
desc_es: Una base negra con actitud propia. Estos leggings de cintura alta combinan una silueta entallada hasta el tobillo con detalles distintivos en tono oliva dorado. El diseño incorpora una cinturilla ancha y elástica que se sitúa por encima de la cintura natural para ofrecer cobertura y sujeción. Confeccionados en un tejido ligero, suave y de tacto liso con ligera elasticidad, se adaptan con naturalidad al movimiento. Ideales para entrenamientos exigentes o momentos de descanso.
details_en:
· Composition: 95% polyester and 5% elastane
· Lightweight, soft, smooth, and slightly elastic fabric
· High waist with a wide elastic waistband
· Ankle length
· Wrinkle-resistant fabric
· Hand or machine wash at a maximum temperature of 45 °C
· Do not soak for prolonged periods
· Do not bleach
· Made-to-order pieces with worldwide shipping
